handshake.title: Quality Runner × Tenure: Values-driven repository debt

roles.creator: The team owns what quality means, which standards are active, where they apply, and the repair policy.
roles.system_or_ai: Quality Runner evaluates reviewed standards, preserves finding provenance, and organizes bounded remediation. A reviewing agent participates in the historical case.
roles.human: The human owns semantic dispositions, source repair, and release decisions.

claim_boundary: The headline case is the historical Tenure reconciliation: 4,022 raw findings became 537 retained raw rows and 0 open actionable findings.
The baseline was dirty and historical; it is not a current passing gate or deployment receipt.
The synthetic partial-js fixture remains a reproducibility appendix, not the headline case.
